recognize_zh: 周邊血片中一個中型細胞，核圓形偏位、染色質粗塊狀，細胞質深藍色並有核旁淡染區（perinuclear hof），即循環中的漿細胞；單張只見一個細胞，無法據此計算是否超過 20%。
features: Single medium-sized cell with round, eccentrically placed nucleus
Coarse, clumped (clock-face-like) chromatin without conspicuous nucleolus
Moderate deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a paler perinuclear zone (hof)
Background red cells with rouleaux-like stacking
Refractile crystalline/debris artifacts and a weakly stained, yellow-tinged preparation
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single circulating plasma cell with an eccentric round nucleus, coarse chromatin, and deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a perinuclear hof. Background red cells show rouleaux-like stacking, and refractile debris artifacts are present. Only one plasma cell is shown, so the proportion of circulating plasma cells cannot be assessed from this image. In a patient with myeloma and leukocytosis, a manual differential showing ≥5% circulating plasma cells (current WHO/IMWG threshold; historically ≥20%) would support plasma cell leukemia.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasmacytoid lymphocytes are polytypic, have less eccentric nuclei and occur with other reactive lymphocyte forms rather than a clonal CD38+/CD138+ population.
LPL shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes to plasmacytoid cells that express CD19/CD20 with MYD88 L265P.
Plasmablasts are larger with prominent nucleoli and open chromatin, often EBV-associated.
